lesson.title: A fresh bar question
lesson.subtitle: P3 bridge and P4 bar-chart revision
lesson.objective: Add the two tallest bars of a bar chart.
lesson.story: The bar chart shows club members for Art, Chess, Swim, Music and Drama.

steps.title: Add the two tallest bars
steps.prompt: Find the two tallest bars and add their values. What is the total?
hints: First find the tallest bar, then the next tallest.
Read every bar with the scale of 10, then put the values in order.
The two tallest bars are Chess (60) and Drama (50).

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: How do you pick the two bars to add?

choices.label: The two tallest bars always stand next to each other somewhere on the chart.
Add the first two bars on the left, because those are the ones read first.
Compare all the heights, then take the two highest, wherever they are.

hints: Think about which bars the question asked for.
The tallest bars could be anywhere along the chart.
Look at every bar before you choose.
Choose the explanation about comparing all the heights.
